lines.emitted_text: nhkwnho kvwaluhtsele analhinvli ale utsi ale toyititlv tanitoke unatanvhse wikvwhayanihske'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏂᏣᏘᏃ ᎠᏂᏁ ᎬᏩᏓᏡᏫᏍᏕᎢ; ᎯᎠᏃ ᏂᎬᏩᏪᏎᎴᎢ, ᎬᏂᏳᏉ, ᏣᏥ ᎠᎴ ᎢᏣᎵᏅᏟ ᏙᏱᏗᏢ ᏗᎨᏣᏲᎭ.
lines.english: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
lines.emitted_text: unitsathino anine kwatalhuwhihste'i hi'anho nikvwawehsele'i kvniykwo tsatsi ale itsalhinvtli toyittlv tiketsyoha

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏚᏁᏤᎴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ, ᎦᎪ ᎡᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
lines.english: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
lines.emitted_text: tunhetselenho hi'a nuwehse'i kako etsi ale otsalhinvtli'

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎬᏩᏚᏫᏛᏃ ᏚᎧᎿᎭᏂᏙᎸ ᎤᏬᎸ ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏂ ᏚᎧᎾᏅ ᎯᎠ ᏄᏪᏎᎢ; ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎡᏥ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏣᎵᏅᏟ?
lines.english: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
lines.emitted_text: kvwathuwitvnho tukhanhanitolv uwolhv na'v anini tukhanhanv hi'a nuwehse'i khvnhiyukwo etsi ale otsalhinvtli'

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎩᎶᏰᏃ ᎤᏁᎳᏅᎯ ᎤᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎾᏛᏁᎮᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᎩᏙ, ᎠᎴ ᎡᏥ.
lines.english: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
lines.emitted_text: khiloyhenho unelhanvhi utulihskv natvnehehsti nahski tsohstatanhvlhi ale vkito ale etsi
